text: {"batchcomplete":true,"query":{"pages":[{"pageid":24307466,"ns":0,"title":"Harmonic progression (mathematics)","extract":"In mathematics, a harmonic progression (or harmonic sequence) is a progression formed by taking the reciprocals of an arithmetic progression, which is also known as an arithmetic sequence.\nEquivalently, a sequence is a harmonic progression when each term is the harmonic mean of the neighboring terms.","description":"Progression formed by taking the reciprocals of an arithmetic progression","descriptionsource":"local"}]}}
